request.query: glossier.com company profile: industry, number of employees, countries it sells to, website languages, how its team works (remote, hybrid, or office), and whether it is hiring
request.systemPrompt: Research the company that owns the website glossier.com. Prefer the company's own site (about, careers, help, store) and reputable business sources. Report facts only. If a fact cannot be determined, use "unknown" for strings, 0 for numbers, false for booleans, and an empty list for arrays. Never guess.
additionalQueries: glossier.com careers: open roles, remote or hybrid or in-office work, office locations
glossier.com about us: company size, headquarters, and countries or markets served
glossier.com online store e-commerce platform and tech stack

highlights.query: company size, markets served, remote or office work, open roles, online store platform

employee_count.description: Approximate total number of employees; 0 if unknown

sells_to.description: Who the company primarily sells to

online_store_platform.description: E-commerce platform behind its online store (e.g. 'Shopify'); 'none' if it does not sell online; 'unknown' if it cannot be determined

countries_served.description: Countries or regions it sells or ships to, one per item. If it serves many, list its largest markets, or a count such as '150+ countries'

website_languages.description: Languages its website, store, or help pages are offered in

work_model.description: How most employees work, from its careers pages and job posts: remote-first, hybrid, or in an office

actively_hiring.description: Whether its careers page or job boards list open roles right now

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether the company's core product involves customers' health or financial records (health tracking, banking, insurance, lending). Taking card payments at checkout does not count

properties.name: Glossier, Inc.
properties.description:
Here at Glossier, beauty is about you. From our formulas to packaging, playful shades to seriously-great skincare—Glossier was built to make beauty accessible and uncomplicated. Before we launched Glossier in 2014, we started as Into The Gloss. A beauty website and community devoted to sharing real information with real people, about really amazing products. It’s where we realized that beauty shouldn’t be built in a boardroom—it should be built by you. This ethos gave birth to our philosophy: Skin First. Makeup Second™. We prioritize skincare because we believe that healthy skin is the best foundation.

We believe in thoughtful design and cultivating conversations. It’s at the core of everything we do—the starting point of all our makeup, skincare, bodycare, and fragrance products. At Glossier, beauty is about celebrating freedom of expression, individuality , and having fun. Our Skin First. Makeup Second™ approach ensures that every product supports your skin’s health, allowing your makeup to enhance rather than mask your natural beauty.
